title: cornus capitata subsp. angustata
intro: Cornus capitata subsp. angustata, commonly known as the Chinese dogwood or Chinese flowering dogwood, is a plant species in the Cornaceae family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include lowering blood pressure, reducing inflammation, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Cornus capitata subsp. angustata include anti-diabetic, anti-inflammatory, and cardio-protective effects, which may be attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides. These bioactive compounds are believed to contribute to the plant's medicinal properties, although further research is necessary to confirm its efficacy.
